purpose: wrapUpのBEFORE。持ちこまれた日：図書館カウンターに、なぞの古写真
scene: The front counter of the warm town library as a miniature clay diorama, full series color. ANCHORS that must persist into the AFTER image: the wooden counter running along the lower third, a green desk lamp at its left end, and a tall bookshelf wall behind. Mood NOW: an elderly woman in a cardigan gently places ONE small sepia-toned old photograph (a tiny aged rectangle, the only sepia element) on the counter; a young librarian leans in, curious; a small paper sleeve and white gloves lie ready. Quiet mystery, soft afternoon light. No readable text anywhere.
composition: Interior medium shot from a fixed vantage: counter lower third, green lamp left, bookshelf wall behind. The SAME camera and anchors reappear in the AFTER image. The sepia photo is a small prop, everything else in bright series clay colors.

elderly woman placing a small sepia photo
